20 Days — Ancient Kingdoms, Misty Highlands & the Tropical South

Sri Lanka Ultimate Southern Sun & Cultural Odyssey

💰From $2,890🕐20 Days / 19 Nights📍15 destinations👥Deep travellers⚡Pace: Moderate📅Best: November to April

Tour Highlights

  • Wilpattu National Park full-day safari
  • Anuradhapura sacred ruins & Mihintale sunset
  • Sigiriya Rock Fortress sunrise climb
  • Scenic train — Nanu Oya to Ella
  • Horton Plains & World's End walk
  • Mirissa blue whale watching
  • Sinharaja UNESCO Rainforest trekking
  • Galle Dutch Fort exploration
  • Madu River mangrove boat safari
  • Udawalawe elephant safaris
